summary: Run the uploaded ProcureSprint zip with Vite and show the preview as it is: 52 pages (foundations, components, templates, screens, validation, 4 archetype templates, 42 buyer and supplier module pages, not-found), unchanged apart from Vite asset paths.

sources.label: procuresprint.zip
sources.status: read-only; never modified; unpacked once into a separate empty folder and copied into this project

confirmed: The person wants a preview of the connected folder's HTML, then will enhance it [message]
The folder is the Procuresprint 2.0 HTML design system; README says open index.html or serve the folder [README.md]
Pages join the shell with <body data-shell="buyer|supplier" data-root=".." data-module="..."> and relative links [README.md, assets/ps.js]
Fonts: Gilroy (if installed) then Plus Jakarta Sans from Google Fonts; icons: Material Symbols Rounded from Google Fonts [README.md, every page head]
Layout is 100% fluid; breakpoints 600 / 905 / 1240 / 1440; tested 320 to 2560 px [README.md, tokens.css]
decisions: Original directory structure kept at the project root (index.html, components.html, templates.html, screens.html, validation.html, modules/, templates/) so every relative link and data-root value works unchanged; vite.config.js build input extended to include modules/ and templates/.
Stylesheets moved to src/styles (tokens.css, ps.css, docs.css) and linked by absolute path so Vite bundles them; tokens.css keeps the Procuresprint tokens verbatim and appends Studio role aliases.

Shell and runtime scripts (ps.js, workbench.js, ps-charts.js) are classic scripts that share globals (window.PS, window.PAGE, window.H), so they are served verbatim from public/assets/js; converting them to ES modules would change execution order and is deferred to the enhancement phase.
The confirmed Premium Storefront template is overridden by the supplied Procuresprint design system, which the design brief makes law (see design-blueprint.direction.rationale).
Nothing in the connected folder is modified; the product is a faithful copy of the uploaded zip with path rewrites only.
deferred: Enhancement requests (the person said they come after the preview)
Sign-in, session expiry and role guards: the prototype has no authentication; shells are chosen per page by data-shell
A typed services/api layer and openapi.yaml: every page carries its own illustrative sample data in an inline script, as the source does; moving data behind services is an enhancement, not a preview
Self-hosting Plus Jakarta Sans and Material Symbols (the source loads them from Google Fonts)
